name: MolProbity
summary: All-atom validation of protein, nucleic-acid and complex structures.

steps: Read the maintainer installation guide and check its current prerequisites, especially legacy PHP 5.6 and build dependencies; verify that the host can provide them without replacing the system PHP used by other applications.
Plan a user-owned local installation. The maintainers restrict deployment to individual machines or restricted-access private networks; do not expose a MolProbity site to the public Internet.

Review and pin the maintainer's bootstrap script and every source it downloads before running anything. Its setup can fetch and compile multiple components; this catalog does not execute the bootstrap or change system services.
If a browser interface is needed, follow the maintainer's localhost-only PHP guidance. If only command-line validation is needed, review the relevant installed tools without starting a web service.
install.verify_note: Use the maintainer's local verification instructions on a small public structure and record the installed component versions and whether only a local command line or localhost service was enabled.

notes: MolProbity is guidance-only because the documented local setup is a multi-component source build with legacy PHP and explicit deployment restrictions. The public website is not a substitute for the user's local installation.
